import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 参数 ===
width = 60       # 总宽 (mm)
height = 40      # 总高 (mm)
length = 100     # 长度 (mm)
wall = 4         # 壁厚 (mm)
hole_d = 6       # 安装孔直径 (mm)

# === 建模 ===
outer = cq.Workplane("XY").box(width, length, height)
inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(width - 2 * wall, length, height - wall)
    .translate((0, 0, wall))
)
result = outer.cut(inner)

# 两侧安装孔
result = (
    result
    .faces(">X").workplane()
    .rect(length - 20, 0, forConstruction=True)
    .vertices()
    .hole(hole_d)
)
result = (
    result
    .faces("<X").workplane()
    .rect(length - 20, 0, forConstruction=True)
    .vertices()
    .hole(hole_d)
)

show_object(result)
